items.label: Keep Essentials Within Reach
items.value: This set of 2 C-shaped tables easily slides under your couch or bed (15.35” D x 11.41” W x 23.2” H), perfect for small spaces. Store snacks, drinks, and remotes within arm’s reach. They also serve as a workstation for your laptop and make ideal bedside tables

items.label: Built to Last
items.value: This couch table features a powder-coated metal frame made from thick carbon steel tubes, enhancing stability and durability. The tv tray can support up to 22 lbs, making it a reliable choice for your home

items.label: Industrial Rustic Charm
items.value: This end table effortlessly combines a rustic brown engineered wood top with black matte steel, creating an elegant look. Its natural wood texture and simple design seamlessly blend with modern or retro furniture, enhancing your home decor with charm and beauty. The top of the side table are crafted from FSC-certified wood panel

items.label: Easy to Assemble and Maintain
items.value: Assembly is a breeze with simple construction and clear instructions. Once assembled, this handy c table keeps essentials within reach. Clean up is quick—just wipe away stains with a damp cloth for effortless maintenance

items.label: 4 Adjustable Feet
items.value: The c shaped side table base includes adjustable foot to accommodate uneven floors while preventing scratches on your flooring
